//: Strict declaration check for UDG-owned packages, required by ADR-0002. It typechecks the *emitted declarations* of @udg/protocol and @udg/config with skipLibCheck: false, so a mistake in UDG's own published type surface stays a build failure even in the two projects where vendor declaration checking is excepted. It deliberately excludes apps/server and never imports @colyseus/core, @colyseus/sdk or @colyseus/ws-transport: the only third-party declarations it sees belong to @colyseus/schema, which measure clean. Run it after pnpm run build:libraries, which produces the declarations it reads.
